The '''''Astral Jester''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] whose [[Unidentified Astral Jester captain|captain]] hoped to lay a claim to a new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] leading through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Eventually, he disappeared during a journey into that region.<ref name="Lessons">{{FFG|story=Lessons from the Past|book=Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|text=''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook}}</ref>
